# Optional Moxie Docs synchronization

Moxie Docs is an optional documentation aid. Its absence, authentication state,
or availability must not block repository inspection, editing, testing,
committing, or pull-request work. The repository's `AGENTS.md`, authoritative
documents, source conventions, and test commands remain the required guidance.

## When to use this

Use this workflow only when the user explicitly requests Moxie Docs. Do not infer
its use from an ordinary source edit, new API, workflow change, or pull request.

## Workflow

1. When requested — `moxie.get_ai_context` (repository: "lwhite702/DRX_Primary") for
   current status, conventions, verified build/test/lint commands, and open gaps.
   Use the commands it returns; don't guess them.
2. Use `moxie.get_doc_impact` with the file paths you'll
   change. It returns the conventions, gaps, and docs whose evidence overlaps
   those paths.
3. Make your change, following the conventions `moxie.get_ai_context` returned.
4. In the same PR — for each doc obligation, `moxie.propose_doc_update` with the
   title and markdown. Moxie resolves the target path; you write the file into
   your branch so docs land with the code. If a path has no doc obligation, say
   so — don't fabricate filler.
5. If your change DELETES code — pass those paths as `deletedPaths` to
   `moxie.get_doc_impact`. For any doc it flags as orphaned (all its cited code is
   gone), call `moxie.propose_doc_removal` and delete the returned path in this PR.
6. Run the verified commands `moxie.get_ai_context` returned when they remain
   applicable to the current checkout.

## Don't

- Don't hardcode commands or conventions from this file — fetch them live.
- Don't add docs that only restate file or component names.
- When you edit an existing doc, fix every stale section in it, not just yours.
